lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in vertical columns and horizontal rows across the visible flank region posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the circular high-luminance nodes, forming a grid-like structural pattern across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge feature in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from specular highlights on the dorsal edge to deep shadows on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct rectangular area of high-luminance pixel values and altered surface texture located on the lower flank, immediately posterior to the vertical gill-slit markings.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-saturation yellow, vertically-compressed objects in the foreground and near the dorsal surface, and a single thin, dark, elongated object attached to the shark's mid-flank.
